paper.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds

scope.read_scope_note: Text extraction only; figures, tables/layout and supplementary files have not been independently checked

analysis_projection.summary_excerpt: Dream-RSI is an author-reported framework that turns completed discovery trees from LLM-driven search into replay simulators ('worlds') for cheap off-policy evaluation of exploration policies, then redeploys the best policy online in a recursive loop. A lightweight orchestration layer makes branching, batching and stopping explicit while […]

mutable: Exploration policy code (only component changed across rounds)

experiment_author_claim.result: Author-reported 2.43x and 1.79x fewer generations on VGG16 and LayerNorm; 2.09x and 1.44x higher performance on ConvDiv and ConvMax under comparable budgets

evidence_anchors.claim: The framework makes exploration explicit and programmable via a lightweight orchestration layer while leaving the base agent unchanged.
evidence_anchors.quote: leaving the underlying base agent unchanged

evidence_anchors.claim: Completed discovery trees are reused as replay simulators so alternative policies can be scored from stored outcomes without rerunning the agent.
evidence_anchors.quote: no rerun of the coding agent or evaluator is needed
